After the caster’s whole turn, the golem reaches a legal target and hits for a rolled 2d10 total of 13. It cannot also open its Slow Aura, and another owned device cannot use another offensive companion Action that numbered round.

IN4-10-B: A caster has only 6 RP or exactly 20 normal HP, with no genuine cost exception. The cast cannot commit. Temporary HP does not cure either shortage. A real price waiver could alter only the RP check; it still requires the twenty-HP payment, unused named use and all other eligibility.

preservation.text: IN6-07-A: A Cleric-created Wraith hits for 17 necrotic after defenses. An eligible target has 5 temporary HP and 7 ordinary HP, so eligible actualDamageDealt is 12; the 5 excess is not counted. Base lifetap healing is 6. This Wraith has actual current HP 97 and maximum 100, with no other healing modifiers, and regains only 3. The Cleric receives no healing, and the unused 3 is not stored.

IN6-07-B: Passing through 15 feet of ordinary wall costs 30 feet from Fly 40, leaving 10 feet of movement only if the Wraith can end legally. It gets no sight or attack through that wall and cannot carry a real chest through it. Full suppression ends this particular manifestation instead of storing it for reappearance; its actual cargo drops on the last legal open side.

preservation.text: IN6-09-A: One actual Undead has a documented CR 2 profile; a second creature is Undead with no recorded CR. The paid cast can establish a binding only on the first after its failed WIS and available hard-control admission. The unrecorded CR is not silently treated as 2 or a successful diagnostic. Both are preexisting bodies; no HP, equipment or corpse allocation is created.

IN6-09-B: A binder already has two relations and declares which old relation a new successful binding would replace. The new target succeeds on WIS, so the old relation stays and the paid 13 RP is spent. On a later actual successful replacement, the released creature keeps its real body and spent turn budget; it does not take an immediate bonus turn. A commanded existing companion still needs its original owner's real phase and structural allowances.

preservation.text: IN6-11-A: A legal corpse becomes one Ghast, not several generic zombies. Its base HP is 50 before actual qualified modifiers, its real missing hand remains missing, and its real armor is neither repaired nor duplicated. It cannot act in the creation numbered round. On a later lawful command it chooses its 15-foot exhalation instead of its melee attack, spending the same shared offensive allowance; the cone can affect allies.

IN6-11-B: A creator already controlling a Ghoul and a Wight successfully creates a Mummy and releases the declared Ghoul relation. The Ghoul remains a real animation at its existing HP and gains no immediate bonus turn or refreshed corpse status. The Mummy uses base HP 70/AC 16 and its distinct strike, subject to real modifiers. Neither released Ghoul nor Mummy gains CR 2 merely because Command Undeath requires that rating.
